title: Install and Configure Vercel Web Analytics
behindTheScenes: Vercel Web Analytics added, to see how much the app is used

title: Install and configure Vercel Speed Insights
behindTheScenes: Vercel Speed Insights added, to measure how fast pages load for real visitors

title: Add date dividers to bill list grouping by month and day
whatsNew: A group's bill list is now grouped under month and day headings, like Splitwise's activity feed

title: Spending thresholds, period comparison on Your Stats, and snapshot category tracking
whatsNew: Spending thresholds: set a monthly budget per category for yourself, and see how this month is going on Your Stats
Your Stats compares each period with the one before (▲/▼ vs last period), and gains a "By category" breakdown
Leaving a group now keeps a per-category record of your spending in it, so your category totals stay complete

title: Your Stats UX: default period, thresholds position, and tiered period navigation
whatsNew: Your Stats opens on the current month, and you can choose any other period as your default
The spending thresholds section can sit at the top or the bottom of Your Stats
Extra ‹‹ / ›› arrows on the stats period selector jump a whole month or year at a time
Fixed the thresholds page and Your Stats hanging on "Loading…" with no explanation when something failed to load

title: Period selector polish, layout fixes, and merged share/PDF button
whatsNew: The stats period arrows are bigger and easier to tell apart, and week view shows which year you're in
"Import bills from Splitwise" moved to the group's own settings, under a new "Import data" section
Share and Download PDF are now one button that opens a small menu
Settle-up rows keep the amount and its button together on the right when they wrap

title: Bill deletion, sharing, and per-bill actions menu
whatsNew: Select several bills at once to delete or share them together
Each bill row has a ⋮ menu: Select, Share or Delete that one bill
Export a whole group's bills as a spreadsheet (CSV) from the settle-up recap
Group admins can delete every bill in a group at once, from a new Danger zone in group settings, optionally clearing payment history too

title: Item editing, shared stats default period, and section dividers
whatsNew: Edit any item in place: tap its name, unit price, quantity or total to change it
Item rows show unit price × quantity next to the total
Group Stats remembers the same default period as Your Stats
Thin dividers between sections on the group page, group settings and stats pages
Fixed clearing a price field saving it as zero instead of keeping the old value

title: Search, tag filter, and price-range filter for a group's bill list
whatsNew: Search a group's bills by title or note
Filter bills by category (match any or all of the ones you pick) and by price, with a two-handle slider or by typing exact amounts

title: Bill row polish: select-mode alignment fix, per-bill status, front-page reshape
whatsNew: Each bill row shows its total, and whether you borrowed, lent or aren't involved
The groups list is paginated, with "Create a new group" moved below it
Group and bill rows sit on a faint tinted card
Fixed the checkbox in select mode sitting below the bill name instead of beside it

title: Fix silently-wrong stats/badges: surface fetch errors, auto-retry on 401
whatsNew: Fixed stats showing zero and bills showing "not involved" when loading had actually failed: errors are now shown instead of looking like empty data
If your session has expired, the app quietly refreshes it and tries again once before showing an error
Groups with a long imported history load reliably, fetched in pages instead of one huge request

title: Speed up the group page and stats pages: caching + parallel fetches
whatsNew: Going back to a group or stats page you just visited shows it instantly, then refreshes in the background
First loads are faster: data is fetched in parallel instead of one request after another

title: Windowed-then-backfilled stats loads; unify the group page's bill fetches
whatsNew: Stats pages show this year and last year straight away, then load older history in the background, with a note while they do
The group page loads its bills once instead of twice

title: Backdate a bill's date; review + proof-check unresolvable Splitwise payers
whatsNew: Change a bill's date (backdate or postdate it) by tapping the date on the bill
Splitwise import: expenses it can't work out on its own (no clear payer, or several payers) now get a review step instead of being skipped or guessed
Splitwise import ends with a proof-check comparing the app's balances against Splitwise's own

title: Rename header + version, and keyboard navigation across the app
whatsNew: The header now reads "Expense Splitter", with the version number underneath
Keyboard shortcuts: ↑/↓ and Enter to move through and open bills or groups, ←/→ to change page or stats period, / to search, Escape to close menus
Page buttons stay pinned to the bottom of the screen instead of jumping around

title: Uneven splits on Splitwise import; collapsible bill search
whatsNew: Splitwise import: each person's share becomes its own item, so imported bills are as editable as any other, and uneven splits can be entered in the review step
Search and filters start tucked away behind a "Search" button, and the search section moved above "Add a bill"
The create-bill button is now called "Add"

title: Search alignment fix, import proof-check fix, guest deletion, nicer PDF recaps, recurring-bills button
whatsNew: Group admins can permanently delete an archived guest who has no history in the group
Stats pages can be shared as a recap (text or PDF), like bills and settle-up
PDF recaps no longer end with a blank page, and table rows don't split across pages
Fixed the Splitwise import proof-check ignoring payments already recorded in the group
The recurring-bills link is now a proper button, and the Search button sits at the right edge

title: AI-assisted wizard for categorizing bulk-imported bills
whatsNew: A new wizard (in group settings) to categorise bills in bulk, mainly for a Splitwise import's backlog: it reuses Splitwise's own categories, asks your AI provider about the rest, and spots common words across bills so one tap can categorise them all. Nothing is saved until you review it

title: Categorization wizard fixes, category color picker, recurring-bills button color
whatsNew: Categorisation wizard: tell the AI what your bill titles mean in your own words, better spotting of repeated shop names, and an "Applied ✓" confirmation
Pick any colour for a category, and change an existing category's colour by tapping its dot
The recurring-bills button matches the colour of "Add"

title: Spending graphs page (line + donut charts), personal-spend convention, chart smoothing
whatsNew: New Graphs pages, for Your Stats and for each group: a smooth line chart of spending over time and a donut chart by category. Tap a slice to follow that category in the line chart
Personal graphs include groups you've left, like Your Stats does

title: Polish: recurring-bills button, Group Stats header, finer graph granularity
whatsNew: Graphs plot in finer detail: each bill this month, each day over four months, each week over the year
"Select" is now "Select bills", and Group Stats shows the group's name under its title
Fixed button-style links showing an underline

title: Pie chart fix, revert graph granularity, layout bug fix, login/settle-up polish
whatsNew: Fixed thin slices of the donut chart drawing outside the ring
Graphs are back to their calmer detail (days for a month, months for longer periods)
Fixed a very long bill or group name with no spaces pushing the page sideways on a phone
The sign-in page opens on the Password tab
The recurring-bills button is now plain text next to "Select bills"

title: Fix bill-row overflow (for real this time), center recap actions, close magic-link account-creation hole
whatsNew: Fixed long bill rows still pushing the page sideways on a phone
Magic-link sign-in no longer creates a new account by accident: an unknown email is told to register instead
The Share and Export buttons at the end of a group page are centred
Fixed groups with many bills timing out while loading, with database indexes on the most-used lookups

title: Settings page + username change, Splitwise settle-up fix, RLS perf fix, README rework
whatsNew: A new Settings page (account menu → Settings): change your display name, dark mode, currency, budgets and scan settings in one place
Splitwise import: settle-up transfers now come in as payments instead of bills titled "A paid B"
Large groups load much faster (about 9 seconds down to a third of a second for a group with 1,100 bills)
behindTheScenes: README shortened from about 1,500 to 650 lines

title: Password reset + personal spending
whatsNew: Forgot your password? A reset link from the sign-in page now works, including for accounts first created with a magic link
A new Personal space for tracking your own spending, with categories, budgets, scanning, recurring bills and stats, without making a group of one

title: Performance: boot splash, prefetching, persisted caches, query optimizations
whatsNew: A splash screen while the app starts, only when there's nothing to show yet
Your recent groups are loaded in the background, so opening one is usually instant
Refreshing the page no longer blanks the groups list, a group or the stats pages for a moment
A group's first visit shows recent bills straight away and fills in older history after
A group page only reloads when that group changes, not any group you're in

title: Bank statement import for the Personal space
whatsNew: Import a bank statement into your Personal space (in its settings), from a CSV export or a PDF read by your AI provider. Categories are suggested, repeats and subscriptions are spotted, and spending already recorded in another group is flagged. Nothing is saved until you confirm it

title: Bank import: Excel support, AI-assisted column detection, and an opt-out
whatsNew: Bank import accepts Excel files too, handy on a phone
Better at reading amounts in different formats, and fixed some debits being read as credits
Edit a transaction's description before it becomes a bill
With an AI provider set up, it double-checks which column is which, and tells you when it changed something. You can switch this off

title: Fix Excel import: wrong read-excel-file export, no header-row scan
whatsNew: Fixed Excel bank statements being read as empty, and statements with a summary block above the column titles. Italian column names are recognised too

title: Bank import: fix mobile overlap, loading spinners, faster fetches, full-text descriptions
whatsNew: Bank import: fixed rows overlapping on a phone, shows a spinner while reading and importing, starts faster, and shows full descriptions instead of cutting them off

title: Speed up bills RLS; remove bank-import recurring detection
whatsNew: Bank import no longer guesses subscriptions: unrelated payments through the same processor (like PayPal) were being mistaken for them
Faster loading of bills for large groups

title: Bank import: one-at-a-time review wizard with resumable drafts
whatsNew: Bank import reviews one transaction at a time, with Back to fix an earlier one and a progress count
Each confirmed transaction is saved straight away, and an unfinished import can be resumed later from group settings

title: Bank import: bring-your-own-AI-chat CSV path, less conservative category prompt
whatsNew: Bank import without an API key: copy a ready-made prompt into any AI chat app, then paste back the table it gives you
Category suggestions make a best guess more often instead of leaving most things blank

title: Bill page: hide "you lent" in Personal, kill flash-then-hide UI, trust bank category columns
whatsNew: The Personal space no longer shows "You lent / You borrowed" on each bill
Fixed the bill page briefly flashing "Paid by" and "split with" rows in the Personal space before hiding them
Bank import uses the bank's own category column when there is one: you match each bank category to yours once, and it's remembered

title: Add a formal test suite (Vitest) + CI
behindTheScenes: An automated test suite (112 tests at the start), run on every pull request together with lint and a build

title: UI declutter round 1: icons, and move Invite/Recurring bills into Settings
whatsNew: Icons for Search, Share, Settings and Stats on the group page, in its header
Export as CSV moved into the Share menu
Invite and "Add recurring bill" moved into group settings
"Select bills" removed: use "Select" in a bill's ⋮ menu, and Escape or Cancel to leave select mode

title: UI declutter round 2: back-arrow icon everywhere, drop member count, fix double divider
whatsNew: Every "← Back" link is now a back-arrow icon
The member count is gone from the group page (it's in group settings)
Fixed a double divider above Quick stats
Your stats on the main page is now the same pie-chart icon

title: Fix two bugs: Your Stats crash, and pagination pill jumping on short pages
whatsNew: Fixed Your Stats going blank after a refresh, and taking other pages down with it
Fixed the page buttons sitting mid-screen and jumping around on short pages

title: Restructure Settings into a sectioned page with a side nav
whatsNew: A new Settings page with a side menu: Profile, Groups (with Leave group), Budgets, Scan, How to Use, About, Updates and Sign out. Tap your name anywhere to open it
"Spending thresholds" are now called "Budgets"
Sign out and Leave group ask for confirmation in a sheet from the bottom of the screen
Settings > Updates shows what's new and lets you check for and install a new version
A one-time prompt to add Spesa to your home screen, when you open it in a browser

title: Bug hunt batch: pagination docking, payment history, date dividers, icon cleanup, group display prefs
whatsNew: Page buttons settle at the bottom of the page again, without jumping when you change page
Payment history is paginated instead of listing every payment at once
Day headings in the bill list show the month too ("Sep 5")
"See graphs" is an icon in the stats page header, and the duplicate "See full stats" link is gone
New switches to hide Quick stats and the "You lent/borrowed" line on bills

title: UI/UX round 5: inline submit buttons, recurring bills, personal share, cleanup
whatsNew: Create group and Add bill have their arrow button inside the text field, shown only once there's something to submit
Recurring bills can be edited, from a ⋮ menu
Fixed a recurring bill starting today only appearing the next day
The Personal space can share a recap as text or PDF, with your total and a breakdown by category
Removed controls that moved to Settings, and made the graphs icon bigger

title: Restructure Group Settings + prefetch/cache DB-backed settings sections
whatsNew: Group settings redesigned with a side menu: General, Members, Guests, Categories, Subscriptions, Data and Danger zone
Recurring bills are now "Subscriptions", inside group settings
Group admins can delete a whole group
Settings sections load instantly from what was loaded before, then refresh

title: Mobile scan/keyboard fixes, Categories polish, sticky filters, price expressions
whatsNew: Scan a receipt: choose between taking a photo or picking a file (PDF, text and HTML too)
Price fields accept simple sums like "2,30-1,25", and iPhone shows a minus key on the number pad
New "Sticky filters" setting keeps a group's search and filters when you open a bill and come back
Categories in group settings have a ⋮ menu
Fixed prices with a comma (like 3,50) being refused by some browsers

title: How to Use guide revamp + README correctness/readability pass
whatsNew: The How to Use guide is easier to browse, by topic, with shorter sections and small illustrations

title: Press-and-hold select, automatic versioning, PWA update fix, Scan Settings redesign, and Bill View polish
whatsNew: Press and hold a bill to start selecting bills
Fixed "Reload to update" in Settings > Updates doing nothing
Scan settings redesigned: one row per method, and only the one you pick opens to show its options
On a bill: Share is an icon in the header, the scan method shows as a small badge, Take photo and Choose file have icons, and adding an item uses the arrow button
The version number now updates itself with every release

title: Bill View progressive disclosure + per-person avatar icons
whatsNew: On a bill, each item's actions (edit, split, delete) show when you open that item, and you can swipe an item left to delete it
A bill with a single item gets a simpler view
Pick an avatar icon for yourself, for all groups or a different one per group, from 16 hand-drawn icons

title: Avatar icon polish, split-with sizes, Add bill unification, small fixes
whatsNew: New "Split-with avatar size" setting: small, medium or large
One "Add bill" form, with an optional amount on the same line as the title
Avatar pickers no longer flash the wrong choice while loading, and some icons were redrawn
Fixes: a grey box behind a single-item bill's amount, the graphs icon out of line, and the add-item arrow appearing before a price was entered

title: Swipe-to-delete on bills/guests, cleaner bill row, collapsed avatar picker
whatsNew: Swipe left to delete a bill or a guest, alongside press-and-hold to select
Bill rows are cleaner: the decorative arrow is gone, and the ⋮ menu sits inside the row
Guests have a ⋮ menu, and "Get claim link" no longer silently fails to share or copy
Press and hold on a bill no longer opens the phone's own link menu
The avatar picker is a compact "Choose your avatar" button that expands in place

title: Fix group-page crash + stale Updates copy
whatsNew: Fixed every group page, including your Personal space, going blank

title: Group page redesign: header, balance summary, Settle Up page + bill rename + row-width fix
whatsNew: The group page has a new header, with the group name on its own line
Under the name, a balance summary shows only what you owe and what you're owed
A new Settle up page lists every debt in the group, yours first, each with Mark paid
Rename a bill from its ⋮ menu or by tapping its title on the bill
Fixed bill rows not filling the full width

title: Group page redesign: History/Record payment pages, Settings > Layout, Quick stats placement
whatsNew: History and Record payment have their own pages, next to Settle up in a row of three buttons
Record payment can use dropdowns or avatar pickers (your choice in settings)
The theme has a "System" option that follows your device
A new Settings > Layout section gathers the display settings: theme, stats defaults and group-page options
Quick stats moved up under the buttons and got slimmer

title: Fix action-row button centering and full-width fill
whatsNew: The Settle up, Record payment and History buttons centre their icon and text, and fill the row

title: Testing infrastructure, README/CLAUDE.md updates, and Supabase migration naming fix
whatsNew: The avatar picker button is announced properly by screen readers
behindTheScenes: Groundwork for testing screens and components
Database migration files renamed to the format Supabase requires

title: UI test suite: 15 new component/page tests, plus a SettleUp error-race fix
whatsNew: Fixed Settle up sometimes hiding an error about the group failing to load
Several icon-only buttons are now named for screen readers
behindTheScenes: Tests for 20 more components and pages

title: Settings > Layout live previews, plus weekly/monthly budgets
whatsNew: Budgets can be weekly or monthly (Settings > Budgets)
Settings > Layout: tap a setting to see a live preview of what it changes
Budgets on Your Stats can now also be hidden, besides top or bottom

title: PDF receipt scanning, Supabase network-safety pass, server-side group balances
whatsNew: Fixed a group's balance briefly showing a wildly wrong number: it's now worked out on the server from the group's complete history
Fixed places where a network hiccup could leave the app stuck instead of showing an error you can retry, like Sign out stuck on "Signing out…"
Free OCR can read a PDF receipt directly, no AI key needed, and no longer picks up the receipt's footer as items

title: Fix bill-deletion race, harden "deleted out from under you" loads, and translate raw AI provider errors
whatsNew: Fixed a bill getting stuck (undeletable, then a confusing error) when deleted right after scanning a receipt into it. Scanned items now save in one go
A bill or group that's already gone when you open it now sends you back with a plain notice instead of an error
A scan that fails says why in plain words, like "Gemini is overloaded right now, try again in a moment"

title: Fix connection-pool exhaustion; per-bill realtime patching and faster group loads
whatsNew: Fixed the app slowing to a crawl after scanning a receipt (deletes not working, bills opening empty, "connection pool" errors), especially with the app open on more than one device. Balances are about 30× faster, and a group's bills load in one quick request
Pages catch up by themselves after your phone was asleep or offline
When a bill changes, the group page refreshes just that bill, using far less mobile data
Removing an item is instant
A bill whose items are still loading says "Loading items…" instead of looking empty

title: Swipe fixes, instant stats, security hardening and safety nets
whatsNew: Swipe-to-remove fixed: bills on the group page slide all the way, rows follow your finger smoothly, a quick flick is enough, and rows never get stuck half-open
Removing an item is a trash-can button, and a bill's details start open
Double-tap someone in a "Split with" row to make them the only one splitting
Stats and Graphs open instantly from a group page
Record payment shows current members, with "Show people who've left" for the rest
Your Stats and Your Graphs load faster, and your overall balance shows straight away
When something goes wrong, the app says so and offers a way back instead of a blank screen
behindTheScenes: Security hardening of the database: tighter rules on who can change a group and its members

title: Pre-approve Claude Code actions; keep a prompt only for destructive SQL
behindTheScenes: Claude Code settings for this repo: routine actions pre-approved, with a confirmation kept for any SQL that deletes something

title: Invite links for new devices, one-item bill split, README and permissions pass
whatsNew: Invite links now work for friends who've never opened the app, instead of a "page doesn't exist" error
Opening an invite or guest-claim link while signed out says why you're asked to sign in, and takes you back to it afterwards, even after confirming a new account's email
The Invite menu on a group's Members page opens fully on screen
A one-item bill has its own "Split with" right under the amount
"Add another item" splits the new item between the same people as the first, and the bill's default is now labelled "Next item split with"

title: AAA themes, focus and touch targets, new category colors, offline fonts, red for money out
whatsNew: Easier to read in light and dark mode: much stronger contrast for text, links and amounts (WCAG AAA), and visible outlines around fields, cards and tiles
In dark mode, buttons use dark text on brighter colours
The selected tab, people who've left a group, and messages no longer rely on a faint shade
A clear green focus ring on every button, link, tab and row for keyboard users
Easier to tap: bigger "Split with" avatars, and fingertip-sized tap areas around small buttons, links, tabs and switches
New category colours that are easier to tell apart, plus a colour-blind friendly option in Settings > Layout
The installed app keeps its own typefaces offline
What you owe is a clear red, the partner of the green for what you're owed
Errors carry a warning sign and their own rust colour, so they never look like a debt

title: Contrast test, dark-mode polish, new icons, loading and empty states, category names on items
whatsNew: Stats bars no longer cut off long category names or big amounts on a phone
In dark mode, menus cast a visible shadow, and the phone's status bar turns dark too
A fresh app icon, with a proper home-screen icon on iPhone
While a page loads you see a faint outline of what's coming instead of "Loading…"
Empty screens say what to do next, with a button to do it
A bill's items show their category's name, under each item or grouped by category with subtotals (Settings > Layout)
Subscriptions show their category's name too
The date at the bottom of a printed recap is dark enough to read

title: Stylesheet split, type/spacing scales, text-size support, pie chart labels, tablet and laptop layouts
whatsNew: Text follows your phone's or browser's own text-size setting
Pie charts print each larger slice's share beside it, and tapping a slice or its legend row highlights both and shows that category's amount in the middle
On a laptop or a tablet held sideways, a bill opens beside the bill list
On tablets and laptops, stats and graphs use the full width, with sections side by side
Text sizes and spacing tidied onto one consistent scale
The "Remove" links for members and guests use the warning colour, and the header's version number is small again

title: Put the design system in the repo, and test it against the app
behindTheScenes: The design system now lives in the repo too (docs/design-system/), with a test that keeps it matching the app

title: Softer outlines: a quiet border for rows and cards, the strong one for fields
whatsNew: Outlines around rows, cards and tiles are softer and match the app's greens, so they no longer overpower what's inside them; text fields keep their clearer outline
The start-date field for a subscription now looks like the app's other fields
